scope: Update21 first three complete microbatches, ranks0/1; diagnostic counters all32 microbatches and updates1–21, all8 ranks. Historical compatible V2 control. Times in microseconds unless named otherwise.
limitations: Historical independent control and profiled three-microbatch prefix establish mechanism only, not full-update or statistically significant speedup.

CUDA API args omit actual event and stream handles for wait calls: exact producer/consumer wait durations and exposed critical path unavailable. Source establishes ordering. Host API time is submission/scheduling, not CPU utilization.
Other-kernel family excludes named EP/NCCL but may contain unclassified waits. Overlaps are not additive.
Quantization kernel counts/grid and phase preserve execution frequency; traces cannot prove tensor values, FP8 metadata equality, gradients, convergence or checkpoint behavior.
No independent rank-clock alignment, remaining29-microbatch device trace, optimizer trace or production PP4/EP32 evidence.
coverage_note: Profiling wrapper records profile_capture.microbatch_calls=32, train_step_calls=1 and optimizer_step_calls=1 on every rank at update21; collected_microbatches=3 only ranks0/1. Generic microbatch_calls_by_step is empty because this wrapper uses the profile-specific hook. Per-group counters cover all boundaries1–21; earlier32-microbatch coverage is supported by64 forward/backward gathers per group/update and unchanged native accumulation, not generic per-microbatch hook records.
